chart_review_items.title: Add reference rules, intervals, and annotations
chart_review_items.current_state: BaseChart offers an overlay slot but shared saved settings have no annotation model.
chart_review_items.desired_outcome: Existing charts express targets, events, and supplied bounds without custom renderer forks.
acceptance_criteria: Fixed horizontal/vertical rule with label works first.
Fixed, whole-population, and selected-population reference scopes are distinguished.
Bands and supplied lower/upper bounds are persisted.
Labels do not cover essential marks at supported desktop sizes.
No inferential confidence claim is made for an unlabeled input interval.

gap_register_items.desired_outcome: Use non-plot views as analytical context
gap_register_items.current_evidence_based_assessment: Summary, source tables, legends, rich explanation and now Metric Card support the workflow; inline table distributions are active.
gap_register_items.remaining_boundary_or_proof_gap: Static text is not live data-bound narrative; metric all-source comparison is not a frozen baseline; every supporting view needs a clear population label.

gap_register_items.desired_outcome: Explain properties, defaults, scales and denominators
gap_register_items.current_evidence_based_assessment: New traces include stack bands, numeric exclusions, date bounds, projections, ECDF denominators and source inputs.
gap_register_items.remaining_boundary_or_proof_gap: No universal every-property provenance contract is established. Test parameter origins, own-versus-peer filtering and overridden settings instead of counting trace dialogs.

current_assessment.statement: BaseChart has an overlay seam. The shared chart settings expose axes and filters but no common reference-mark model. Scatter fits are now implemented; a regression curve does not provide saved target and event controls across other charts.
current_assessment.evidence_scope: Source inspection only; no fresh application browser proof.
